For $m\ge1408$, every affine-linear determinant representation of size $n$, including coefficientwise limits, satisfies $n\ge m^3/(5529600e)$.” “A general supporting theorem applies to a polynomial in $d\ge2$ variables whose first nonzero homogeneous Taylor term has degree $r\ge2$ and no nonzero singular zero. exact_statement:
theorem permanent_cubic_lower_bounds :
    (∀ (m n : ℕ), 1408 ≤ m → HasBorderDeterminant n (permanentPolynomial m) →
      (m : ℝ)^3 / (5529600 * Real.exp 1) ≤ (n : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ (m n : ℕ), 1408 ≤ m → HasExactDeterminant n (permanentPolynomial m) →
      (m : ℝ)^3 / (5529600 * Real.exp 1) ≤ (n : ℝ))
